results.title: Democrats’ Sweep Drives Decline in European Defense Shares - Bloomberg

# European Defense Stocks Slide as Democrats’ Sweep Dents Optimism

European defense stocks slid as the Democrats’ landslide midterm-elections win dented expectations of a further ramp-up in US military spending.
